messages:
maria_sales: FinCorp POC kickoff tomorrow at 10am — need aligned success criteria + security blockers before call. 30m slot. Who can join?

josh_solutions: I can make it. Proposed success criteria draft: p95 latency < 350ms (512 tokens), top-1 accuracy >= 88% on their golden prompts, cost per 10k tokens <= $10. Also need automated eval harness to score.

alex_sre: Technical note: on Dedicated A100 pool with batching=8 we can hit ~250ms p95 for 512 tokens. Need their prompt length distribution and target qps though. KV cache reduces tail latency for repeated prefixes.

olivia_sec: Security checklist items: KMS/BYOK, VPC connectivity (peering or PrivateLink), audit logs, SOC2 report. Customer asked specifically about HSM-backed keys — we support BYOK via customer KMS for Private deployments.

anya_pm: Timeline proposal: 3-week engagement. Week 1: infra + baseline runs. Week 2: eval & prompt tuning. Week 3: acceptance testing + handoff. Need sample prompts + labels from FinCorp by EOD tomorrow to stay on schedule.

josh_solutions: On pricing for the POC: recommend offering trial credits + a short committed Dedicated pool at 50% discount for 3 weeks to cover predictable latency testing. Finance ok with credits but need exact infra estimate.

maria_sales: Customer asked if we can provide an acceptance test harness (automated scoring + pass/fail). Do we have something shareable? :thinking_face:

alex_sre: Yes — we have the poc-evals repo. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/poc-evals (internal). Example run: ```./run_eval --model redwood-3b --prompts prompts.json --metrics accuracy,latency --repeat 3``` Outputs per-prompt latency and top-k metrics.

olivia_sec: Also confirm retention policy: they requested 2 years of audit logs. That's enterprise-only (we default to 90 days). Flag as potential blocker for contract/legal.

anya_pm: Blockers summary: (1) DPA + SOC2 copies needed (legal), (2) long-term log retention request (enterprise tier), (3) KMS/HSM details for BYOK. If any of these are unresolved we escalate to AE/Legal.

josh_solutions: Action items: I'll upload eval prompts template + notebook by EOD. I'll also include an example scoring config: ```scoring: {"accuracy_threshold": 0.85, "latency_p95_ms": 300, "cost_per_10k": 9.0}```

maria_sales: Ok — next steps before kickoff: @josh_solutions share eval template, @olivia_sec answer KMS+retention Qs in the questionnaire, @alex_sre estimate infra cost and latency numbers. I'll confirm discount with finance and send updated POC SOW to FinCorp. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: infra: dedicated-poc cluster provisioned (id: poc-177850).
